scenes.narration: What if the ads in the Target app were worth almost a billion dollars?
They are. Brands pay Target to advertise through a business called Roundel.
Its ad revenue jumped from 649 million dollars to 915 million in 2025.
Target also gets a share of the profits from its store credit cards: 522 million.
Next to 104.8 billion in sales, that's small. But the side businesses keep adding up.
